{{Quote|It took 85 men less than an hour to bring so much chaos and disarray to Ebenmal that the defenders&mdash;over 3,000 Rebels&mdash;surrendered.|''Imperial Atrocities and Other Noble Pursuits'', by Chen Ming-di|<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
'''Ebenmal''' was a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]]<ref name="Jumptrooper" /> located in the [[Ebenmal system/Legends|Ebenmal system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Irnaj sector/Legends|Irnaj sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was on Ebenmal that a [[Battle of Ebenmal|battle]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was fought<ref name="Jumptrooper" /> sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Explain">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' graphic novel]] shows that the Rebel Alliance was founded in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. According to [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' comic]], the events of ''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' happened in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Thus, the battle happened between the two years.</ref> The ancient [[citadel of Ebenmal]], which was said to have never fallen to an invader for over ten thousand years, was attacked by eighty-five Imperial [[Jumptrooper/Legends|jumptroopers]], who brought chaos and disarray. In one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour's]] [[Time/Legends|time]], 3,000 Rebels surrendered. The battle was later mentioned in ''[[Imperial Atrocities and Other Noble Pursuits]]'', by [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Chen Ming-di]].<ref name="Jumptrooper" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ebenmal was mentioned in the "jump trooper" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="Jumptrooper" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ebenmal system, and therefore the planetoid, in grid square K-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
